text:
Priya: Quick check — customer (FinTech POC) wants a committed reserved pool but needs autoscale burst up to 20 GPUs across eu-west/us-west for demo spikes. They asked for an "escrow" style credit to cover burst overage during the 8‑week POC. Can we approve a temporary burst rate override and how do we handle escrow/credits? link to their SOW: https://acme.example/sow :eyes:
Sam: What’s the committed baseline (count + length)? and expected avg vs peak? also which GPU type are they requesting?
Priya: Baseline 8xH100 committed, 8 week POC, avg ~8 GPUs, peaks to 20 for 10–15 min demos. Customer insists on predictable burst price during demo window. They asked for invoice credit rather than immediate overage billing.
Linh: Finance view — we can do a conditional promo: apply a temporary burst premium reduction for the POC and issue a contra credit (escrow) that posts to their first invoice. Need CSM sign-off and legal on refundable credit terms. Proposed: reduce burst premium from +90% to +40% for duration, credit any overage above baseline up to $XXk (capped). Need exact numbers to calculate margin impact.
Omar: Technical note — autoscale across regions + mixed pools means we might fall back from H100 to A100 during peaks. Performance varies; recommend we either: pin model variant to H100 (no fallback) or accept A100 fallback and document QoS. Also add a guardrail to stop autoscale if capacity for H100 falls below 10%:
```
autoscale:
  baseline: 8
  max_burst: 20
  gpu_preference: [H100, A100]
  fallback_policy: allow-A100-after-60s
  guardrail_h100_min_pct: 10
```
Omar: If they want strict demo parity, pin to H100 and charge higher burst premium. If they accept degraded perf, we can keep mixed and lower price.
Sam: For deal desk, we need: committed GPU count, commit term, proposed burst premium, escrow cap amount, and legal clause text. Priya can you confirm numbers?
Priya: Committed 8xH100, 8 weeks, propose burst premium +40% for POC, escrow cap $25k. Also customer cleared security questionnaire (SLA addendum requested).
Alex: Deal desk — please open a ticket with those numbers. I can provisionally approve a temporary +40% burst premium and escrow credit of $25k for the 8‑week POC conditional on: (1) CSM signs SOW amendment, (2) Legal approves escrow/refund clause, (3) Regional pricing parity confirmed. I’ll need final line items in the ticket. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-4821 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Pre-provisioning checks queued for DEAL-4821 — capacity forecast running.
Linh: I’ll run margin calc once ticket has final numbers. Tentative margin looks OK if we cap escrow at $25k.
Priya: Thanks — I’ll draft SOW amendment and loop CSM/legal. I’ll also confirm whether customer will accept A100 fallback for non-critical demos.
Alex: Sounds good, ping me when ticket created and include CSM sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Will do. Thanks all.
